verdict.rationale: Veo has a first-party Gemini API video docs page that describes turning text and images into short videos and refining them via the Interactions API. Community reports of calling the model ID veo-2.0-generate-001 and spending GCP credit confirm hands-on programmatic generation. However, the evidence never documents the job-submission, polling or asset-retrieval workflow. The same docs page also tells users to migrate to other models to avoid service interruptions, which suggests the Veo API path is being phased out. Missing for 10: documented submit/poll/retrieve job flow, explicit download or retrieval of the finished asset, a published API spec, and assurance the endpoint is not being deprecated.
